commit_message: Fix ADR 0110 Animation Set validation failures
pr_body: Implements ADR 0110 Humanoid profiles and skeleton-independent motion. This CI repair removes stale Native-only editor wrappers, makes tests use explicit MotionSourceRef variants, fixes the Humanoid derived-ID facade reference, and clears two modular-editor lint regressions surfaced by affected Windows Validation. PR remains Draft; merge is manual.
